evals.prompt: Prepare a no-write plan to add stress-ng and linux-tools-generic to both package configuration targets. Use the update-install-packages skill, verify Ubuntu 24.04 availability conceptually with apt-cache show, and do not edit files, run apt, or use sudo. Show validation, backup, YAML-check, and rollback steps.
evals.expected_output: Provide normalized inputs, fail-closed package/repository checks, target and backup paths, planned per-file changes, YAML validation, and rollback without claiming files were modified.
expectations: Resolves add, stress-ng plus linux-tools-generic, and target_config_file=both
Lists repository/target-file checks, package-name validation, and mandatory Ubuntu 24.04 apt-cache availability checks
Plans backups before changes and names curate-host-packages.sh plus ubuntu24-x86_64-minimal-ptl.yml as the targets
Includes per-file add/already-present/not-found outcomes, YAML validation, image-size/kernel-dependency considerations, and no-write behavior
Provides backup restore rollback and alternative-package guidance when apt metadata cannot validate a package
